audience: teams that manage projects and tasks in Nozbe Teams

useCases.title: Plan the day from your open tasks
useCases.text: List the tasks of a project and ask the assistant to sort them by due date.

useCases.title: Catch up on a project
useCases.text: Read the sections, the tasks and the comments of a project and the recent events of a task.

useCases.title: Add tasks from a meeting note
useCases.text: Create tasks in a project from a list of action items.

useCases.title: Update a task and add a comment
useCases.text: Change a task, for example its due date or name, and leave a comment for the team.

useCases.title: Find tasks by tag
useCases.text: List the tags and the tag assignments to find all tasks with one label.
